steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Rich Romans lived in domus (single-family houses) with atrium, peristyle gardens and private baths | Key Fact: Most Romans lived in insulae (multi-storey apartment blocks) — cramped, fire-prone and overcrowded | Key Fact: The typical Roman day began at dawn, with business conducted in the morning and leisure in the afternoon | Key Fact: Roman meals: ientaculum (breakfast), prandium (light lunch), cena (main evening meal)
